nvitk.io.writers.nifti
======================

.. py:module:: nvitk.io.writers.nifti

.. autoapi-nested-parse::

   Write volumes to NIfTI (and optional JSON sidecar / header extension) via nibabel.



Attributes
----------

.. autoapisummary::

   nvitk.io.writers.nifti._NIFTI_RESERVED_KEYS


Functions
---------

.. autoapisummary::

   nvitk.io.writers.nifti._jsonable
   nvitk.io.writers.nifti._extract_zooms

Module Contents
---------------

.. py:data:: _NIFTI_RESERVED_KEYS

.. py:function:: _jsonable(value: Any) -> Any

   Recursively coerce a metadata value to a JSON-serializable type (arrays → lists, bytes → str, else ``str()``).


.. py:function:: _extract_zooms(metadata: dict[str, Any], ndim: int) -> tuple[float, Ellipsis]

   Per-axis voxel sizes for the NIfTI header, from metadata spacing keys (defaults to 1.0 when absent).


.. py:function:: write_nifti(path: str, data: Any, *, axes: str | None = None, metadata: dict[str, Any] | None = None, save_metadata_extension: bool = True, **_: Any) -> None

   Save *data* to *path* as NIfTI; writes a sibling ``.json`` when extra metadata is JSON-safe.

   Reorders from ``metadata['axes']`` to *axes* when both differ. Zooms come from ``x_res`` /
   ``y_res`` / ``z_res`` / ``t_res`` (or aliases). With ``save_metadata_extension=True``, a
   nibabel header extension may embed additional JSON metadata.
